scope: Adversarial step-by-step account-to-combat review, including real complete creator, CPU, local and online fights.

commits.change: Isolated journey server, deterministic provider and browser probe
Fresh private trial and rematch identities

reproduce.isolation: The server creates a temporary database and a reference.jpg fixture, prints their location, and removes them on SIGINT/SIGTERM. The QA-only /api/qa/fixture marker is not added to the application server.
browser: Open http://localhost:5381/create in two independently authenticated sessions. Evaluate scripts/journey-browser-probe.js in each tab before walking the UI.
Use disposable accounts, sign out and sign in through the real forms. Upload the printed synthetic JPEG. Include [qa-fail-once] in the description to exercise failed-job recovery with Continuar.
Finish a private trial using real controls; __journeyAudit.startBot() can dispatch normal keyboard events. Evaluate scripts/trial-rematch-regression.js only after the result is visible.

Signed into the workshop without an active trial, evaluate scripts/asset-recovery-browser.js. It guards against the real generation provider, creates a new synthetic character, fails its image requests, and retries. It leaves the recovered trial open.

In the arena lobby outside any room or fight, evaluate scripts/opponent-rejoin-regression.js. It creates a private room, uses real socket peers to leave/rejoin twice, and checks the actual notice after rejoining and exiting.

In the arena lobby outside any room or fight, evaluate scripts/storage-recovery-regression.js. It injects an invalid saved name, remounts through actual navigation, checks the fight form, and restores the prior value.

For a complete online fight, use the real create/join/ready buttons on both tabs. __journeyAudit.startBot([0]) controls the host; startBot([1]) controls the guest. Read state and compare complete server snapshots at identical ticks. No engine state writes are needed.

environment.accounts: Disposable owner and rival accounts with separately verified authenticated identities; isolated temporary SQLite databases.
environment.generation: Real upload, queue, LangGraph pipeline, atlas processing and publication; only design/art generation uses tests/fixtures/creator-provider.ts. No paid AI calls.
environment.controls: Real keyboard events and synthetic touch PointerEvents through the actual UI. Probe reads engine/component state; it never edits HP, positions, stocks, timers, winners or match state.

limits: This is tested coverage, not a proof that every possible sequence or environment is correct.
Deterministic synthetic art does not validate the live AI provider's availability, likeness, or visual output.
Loopback HTTP browser testing does not validate public HTTPS deployment, WAN latency, physical controllers, or physical mobile hardware.
Progress is intentionally local to the browser; authentication protects creator records and reference photos. Previously published art is retained after retirement for existing matches.
